policy.strangeness_source: Oino has travelled away from ordinary life — the call itself does not become a monster

opening.label: invitation refused
opening.note: Sister calls; Oino closes the attic door and stays with the archive/tape.

middle.label: ordinary life ignored while preservation continues
middle.note: Archive and industrial echoes of the call while Oino keeps preserving/transforming instead of returning.

zone.label: reality interrupting desire
zone.note: Irregular knock cuts through the controlled/desired encounter.

ending.label: living relationship accepted
ending.note: Sister's tapping at the table becomes the seed of the changed melody; Oino follows it.

rhythm.pattern: short domestic call — familiar cadence, not metronomic alarm
rhythm.relation_to_music: near CUE_KNOCK; music may breathe around it, not hit as a scare sting

visual_form.primary: attic door, downward eyeline, empty stair light
visual_form.avoid: shock cut to sister's face; sudden loudness spike as horror sting

response.action: Closes the attic door; remains with father's unfinished recording / archive pull.
response.means: Invitation refused — preservation and unfinished music outweigh dinner.

appearances.meaning_label: ordinary life ignored while preservation continues

source.who: someone calling a younger ancestor to dinner
source.medium: worn reel / tape — ancestor-origin footage class preferred

rhythm.pattern: same domestic contour, degraded — dropouts, wow/flutter, partial words
rhythm.relation_to_music: sits under archive ambience; not a hard sync hit
rhythm.bpm_feel: human call filtered through age of medium

visual_form.primary: reel spinning; speaker grille / CRT ghost; lip of a bowl in frame edge
visual_form.avoid: presenting archive call as supernatural jump

response.action: Listens while continuing to search/handle archive materials; does not leave for any table.
response.means: Ordinary life (dinner) ignored while preservation work continues.

appearances.meaning_label: ordinary life ignored while preservation continues

source.medium: alarm / shift horn distorted toward domestic vowels

rhythm.pattern: alarm periodicity that collapses into the sister-call contour (same stress pattern, wrong timbre)
rhythm.relation_to_music: broad cue only — do not cut every transient
rhythm.bpm_feel: mechanical pulse wearing a household shape

visual_form.primary: factory gate / steam; horn geometry echoing open mouth of stairwell light

response.action: Registers the resemblance; keeps moving through eras.
response.means: Domestic invitation buried inside industrial time — still not answered as dinner.

appearances.meaning_label: ordinary life ignored while preservation continues

source.where: digital / possible-future layer of the changing world

rhythm.pattern: notification cluster matching the call's stress: da-da—DA (or local equivalent) without speech
rhythm.relation_to_music: soft UI blip under score; not a jump cue
rhythm.bpm_feel: quantized echo of a human call

visual_form.primary: terminal toast / cursor blink / label flash resembling 'dinner' without spelling a scare
visual_form.avoid: glitch-horror stingers; face in the screen

response.action: Dismisses or scrolls past; hands stay on preservation/control tools.
response.means: Care continues as archive/system work while the living invitation stays unanswered.

source.who: unspecified — Zone does not explain itself

rhythm.pattern: off-grid, incomplete call rhythm — missing the comforting last beat
rhythm.relation_to_music: near CUE_REST / passage; irregularity interrupts mechanical loops
rhythm.bpm_feel: wrong domestic — familiar shape, broken timing

visual_form.primary: passage threshold; no sister body required; knock as space event

response.action: Attention breaks; body orients toward the knock even while desire pulls toward the controlled reunion ahead.
response.means: Reality interrupting desire — the living call pattern returns as interruption, not invitation fulfilled.

source.medium: fingers tapping table / bowl rim — becomes melodic onset

rhythm.pattern: tap pattern = seed of the changed / altered note; related to call contour but newly musical
rhythm.relation_to_music: aligns with CUE_FINAL_PHRASE / living variation — not a scare hit
rhythm.bpm_feel: human, intimate, slightly behind a perfect grid

visual_form.primary: hands at table, untouched bowls, sister present as living person
visual_form.avoid: turning sister into a moral prop or metronome only

response.action: Returns to sister; accepts anger; follows the changed note.
response.means: Living relationship accepted — the call completes as music shared, not archive control.
